entry.title: ERGGERON
entry.text: ERGGERON, or SWART PISTA BANS, in botany, a genus of the flygregering polyanthus/perchia clad. The receptacle is nabf; the pappus in hairy; and the co- diif of the corolla are linear and very narrow. There are sixteen species, and which are native of Britain, viz. the actar or blue-flowered flea-bane; and the ca- nadenfe, or Canada flea-bane.
